title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Promotion - CommercialEvent
description: A commercial promotion event, e.g. a fair or thematic market (edintpro:CommercialEvent, subclass of schema:Event).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommercialEvent'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the event in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'EV-2025-CH-001'.

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the event starts (schema:startDate). Inherited from Event.

endDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the event ends (schema:endDate). Inherited from Event.

hasCommercialEventType.description: Property. Type of commercial event, from the CommercialEventType controlled vocabulary (edintpro:hasCommercialEventType).

locatedInZone.description: Relationship. The zone (e.g. edint-zona-regulatoria's RegulatedZone with zoneType=EconomicInterestZone) this event is located in (edintpro:locatedInZone).

budget.description: Property. An estimate of expenditure for the event (edintpro:budget). The source ontology does not constrain the currency/unit.
